Since 0.1.14. The major version stays 0.

### Thor on LineageOS
These fixes come from running Foldcade on a Thor that moved from stock Android 13 to LineageOS (Android 17).

Home on the bottom screen stays up after you press Home, wake the Thor, or open Android's Settings. On Android 16 and later, a window Foldcade used to hold that screen stopped the Home under it and left the bottom screen black. Foldcade no longer opens that window there (#411).

A game on the bottom screen keeps its brightness while the command center dims the top screen. LineageOS has no separate backlight setting for the bottom screen; it follows the top one, so the top screen's dim used to darken the game too. Where the screens share one backlight, the command center leaves the brightness alone (#412).

### Moonlight
Pairing a computer again lists its games right away. After a reinstall, or Foldcade's data moving to a new system, its earlier pairing no longer counts, but the list of games it had stayed saved. Pairing again listed the same games, so Foldcade saw no change and showed none of them until it restarted (#413).

### ARMSX2
ARMSX2 can keep its data in a folder you choose, through App Data Folder › Custom folder. It still loads its BIOS from its own private folder. When Foldcade puts a BIOS from RomM into the chosen folder's `bios`, it now says to import it in ARMSX2 through ☰ › Setup / Change Folders › Select your BIOS, instead of saying the BIOS is ready. The game still starts (#414).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads Home shortcuts and exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
- On Android 17, Android's folder picker can't choose a folder under `Android/data`. Save sync for an emulator that keeps its saves there needs that emulator's data or save folder moved to shared storage first.
